title: Office Automation | Saylani Mass IT Training
text: Course: Office Automation. Category: Entrepreneurship. Duration: 3 months. Description: Computer fundamentals, hardware & software overview, operating system and file management, and Microsoft Word document creation and formatting. Eligibility: Basic. This course is offered free of cost by Saylani Mass IT Training (SMIT), an initiative of Saylani Welfare International Trust. Admission is via the online registration form at https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll, selecting this course and a preferred campus/city.
